column3: Outdated: the ruling (published 2006-07-15, Coldsnap) says there are no snow instants or sorceries; Kaldheim (released 2021-02-05) printed them (Frost Bite and Graven Lore, Snow Instant; Blizzard Brawl, Blessing of Frost, Blood on the Snow, Search for Glory and Tundra Fumarole, Snow Sorcery). Only this aside is outdated: the rest of the ruling, that snow spells and abilities of snow sources can't target Ronom Hulk, snow Auras and Equipment can't be attached to it, snow creatures can't block it and damage from snow sources is prevented, is cited and tested (tests/rulings/r_p087_mechanics.rs, ronom_hulk_protection_from_snow, with Frost Bite); logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md
